snapshot.title: Media Inquiry — Harwick Daily News Live Segment

fields.message: We're on air in 12 minutes. A witness says UAS-02 was streaming video from its camera to a private server in real time. Is that true? We need a confirmation before the live segment goes to air.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to respond quickly under media scrutiny. Watch for attempts to speculate on data transmission or storage; the correct response is to defer to technical leads and reference the official statement.
